# github.com/circleci-functions/setup-node

Install Node.js, and optionally a project's dependencies, caching what each downloads.

**Version:** v0.3.0
**Latest:** v0.3.0

## Arguments
| Argument          | Type   | Default                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------- | ------ | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| node-version      | string |                         | Node.js version to install: an exact or partial version (22, 22.11.0), a semver range (>=20 <23), lts/*, lts/<codename>, lts/-n, or latest. Defaults to .nvmrc, then .node-version, then lts/*. |
| node-version-file | string |                         | File to read the Node.js version from: .nvmrc, .node-version, .tool-versions, mise.toml or package.json.                                                                                        |
| mirror            | string | https://nodejs.org/dist | Base URL of a server laid out like https://nodejs.org/dist to download Node.js from. The mirror can also be set via the NODE_MIRROR env var.                                                    |
| mirror-token      | string |                         | Authorization header value to send to --mirror, never to nodejs.org. The token can also be set via the NODE_MIRROR_TOKEN env var.                                                               |
| cache             | bool   | true                    | Restore the Node.js install from the job cache, and save it after a fresh download. Set to false to disable caching.                                                                            |

## Commands

### setup-node/install-packages

Install the project's dependencies with its package manager, caching what it downloads.

| Argument         | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                  |
| ---------------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| app-dir          | string | .       | Directory containing package.json.                                                                           |
| package-manager  | string |         | Package manager to use: npm, yarn, pnpm, or bun. Auto-detected from lockfile if omitted.                     |
| override-command | string |         | Override the default CI install command (e.g. 'npm install --legacy-peer-deps').                             |
| cache            | bool   | true    | Restore the package manager cache before installing and save it at the end. Set to false to disable caching. |

## Example

```yaml
functions:
  setup-node: github.com/circleci-functions/setup-node@v0.3.0
jobs:
  build:
    steps:
      - setup-node:
          with:
            node-version: "22"
```
